pairs.why: Same hat in both, but A's felt is smoother and more even like the real cards, while B's surface is grainier and fuzzier, the texture-heavy look the lessons rejected.
A has the cleaner, softly smoothed matte finish of the real shoe and vending-machine cards; B's felt shows visible fuzz grain.
Shapes match closely; A's smoother surface fits the real cards better than B's grainy felt.
A reads as a smoothly rendered game object, while B has a noticeably noisy, fuzzy felt texture.
Both show some felt fuzz, but A's is a bit lighter and its shading cleaner, so it sits slightly nearer the real cards' smooth finish.
Almost identical; B's crown and brim look a touch grainier, so A is marginally closer to the real cards' smoother finish.
A's matte surface is smoother and more even, like the real cards; B's felt is fuzzier and more textured.
A has the smooth but not plastic finish of the real cards, while B adds visible felt grain across the crown and brim.
